Thanks for finding this, very late response and I had nothing to do with creating this mod but I had a look; here’s what I found (in batterySystem.js):

if (id != BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.NIGHTVISION && id != BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.THERMAL_VISION && !config.NoBattery.includes(id) && ((items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.SPECIAL_SCOPE) || (items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.NIGHTVISION || items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.THERMAL_VISION)) || (items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.COLLIMATOR || items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.COMPACT_COLLIMATOR) || (items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.HEADPHONES) || (items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.FLASHLIGHT || items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.LIGHT_LASER_DESIGNATOR || items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.TACTICAL_COMBO)) {
The logic is broken due to operator precedence. NoBattery check only applies to the first two parts, but not the other conditions. Meaning items like Obzor may fall through incorrectly.

Fix:

if (id != BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.NIGHTVISION && id != BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.THERMAL_VISION && !config.NoBattery.includes(id) && ( (items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.SPECIAL_SCOPE) || (items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.NIGHTVISION || items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.THERMAL_VISION) || (items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.COLLIMATOR || items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.COMPACT_COLLIMATOR) || (items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.HEADPHONES) || (items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.FLASHLIGHT || items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.LIGHT_LASER_DESIGNATOR || items[id]._parent == BaseClasses_1.BaseClasses.TACTICAL_COMBO) ) ){
